name: Parasite Therapeutics
description: Personal evidence workspace for mapping autoimmune targets to parasite-derived molecules, ranking scientific confidence, and turning scattered research into experiment-ready briefs.
longDescription: A personal research software project built for my own education and interest in parasite-derived therapeutic candidates. The workspace brings together protein libraries, disease-conditioned target mapping, evidence grading, pathway context, and exploratory research flows so scattered literature can become clearer hypotheses and experiment-ready briefs.
